title: Sequential Microbial Biomass and Nitrogen Extraction
author: maggie.bowman

steps.title: Prepare Soil Subsamples
steps.instruction: Place approximately 8 g of soil subsample into a V-bottomed conical tube. Label the tube and cap with the Cat# and record the soil weight and Cat# on the data sheet.

steps.title: Prepare Vacuum Filtration Setup
steps.instruction: Set up a vacuum filtration system and a clean workspace.

substeps.instruction: Set up a tray with bench paper and wipe the plastic side of the paper with ethanol.
Assemble the vacuum pump, Erlenmeyer filter flask, and Buchner funnel.
Place a stack of 5-8 filters in the funnel and turn on the vacuum pump.

steps.title: Pre-condition Filters
steps.instruction: Prepare the filters by rinsing with K2SO4 and ultrapure water.

substeps.instruction: Pull K2SO4 through the filters three times in total.
Wait a few seconds to ensure all K2SO4 is pulled through (vacuum noise will change).
Add ultrapure water until filters are completely covered.
Vacuum off as much liquid as possible, turn off the vacuum, and remove filters with tweezers.
Spread filters on the clean bench paper tray and dry in the hood overnight.

steps.title: Perform First Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract nitrogen and biomass from non-fumigated subsamples, including blanks.

substeps.instruction: Include at least 3 empty 50 mL conical tubes per day as blanks and carry them through the process.
Add 24 mL K2SO4 to the non-fumigated subsample using a repeat dispenser and cap well.
Place on shaker at 200 rpm for 2 hours at room temperature (20 °C).
Balance samples and centrifuge at 4000 rpm for 20 minutes.
Place a pre-leached filter in a funnel supported by a rack.
Place a scintillation vial with the matching Cat# below the funnel.
Pour the supernatant into the funnel, ensuring filtrate drips directly into the vial, leaving at least 1 cm head space.
Transfer the filter paper back into the conical tube with the soil pellet using ethanol-clean forceps.
In the fume hood, add 2 drops of phosphoric acid to the extract for TOC preservation.
Store extracts at -20 °C.

steps.title: Fumigate Soil Samples
steps.instruction: Fumigate the soil pellet and filter in the fume hood using chloroform. Wear Viton/Butyl gloves over disposable nitrile gloves, a lab coat, and safety glasses.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL chloroform to the soil pellet and filter.
Ensure the tube is labeled and capped securely (chloroform dissolves ink).
Cover tube racks with a black garbage bag and let sit in the dark in the hood for 24 hours.
Remove garbage bags and caps and allow to vent for 48 hours, keeping track of which cap belongs to which tube.

steps.title: Perform Second Extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the extraction process for the fumigated samples, performing K2SO4 addition, filtration, and phosphoric acid addition inside the hood to avoid residual chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Follow the same steps as the first extraction (K2SO4 addition, shaking, centrifuging, and filtration).
Discard the filter from this second extraction.
Rinse and acid wash funnels after use.

steps.title: Sample Disposal or Archiving
steps.instruction: Handle the remaining soil pellets based on the experimental requirements.

substeps.instruction: For isotopic labeling experiments: Archive leftover soil pellets (labeled and unlabeled controls) at 20 °C.
For other experiments: Open all tubes inside the fume hood and allow to dry completely to remove trace chloroform before disposing of tubes, filters, and soil.
